methods.label: Multiply successive defective-draw probabilities
methods.explanation:
For uniform random sampling without replacement, all three items are defective exactly when each successive draw is defective. After each such draw, one defective item and one item overall have been removed, so the successive probabilities are \(\frac4{10}\), \(\frac39\), and \(\frac28\). By the probability multiplication rule,
\[
P(\text{all three defective})
=\frac4{10}\cdot\frac39\cdot\frac28
=\frac1{30}.
\]
methods.levelReason: Successive conditional probabilities give a complete same-level alternative without combination formulas.
